name: quillgeist
description: Compact long AI context while preserving critical evidence, estimate token reduction, and inspect aggregate Quillgeist savings trends.

interface.shortDescription: Compact AI context and measure estimated token savings.
interface.longDescription: Quillgeist compacts long prompts, logs, transcripts, and execution context while preserving high-signal evidence such as errors, requirements, and relevant boundaries. It returns before-and-after estimated token measurements and can report aggregate Quillgeist compaction and savings trends. The initial public ChatGPT plugin does not remotely execute actions on a user's Windows machine.
defaultPrompt: Compact this context before I send it to another model, but keep every error and requirement.
Reduce the token load in this log without removing the evidence needed to debug it.
Show Quillgeist's aggregate token-savings and compaction trend for the last 30 days.
